verdict.rationale: Digits documents an official hosted MCP server at https://api.digits.com/mcp, with OAuth sign-in and setup steps for Claude Desktop, Claude Code, ChatGPT, Cursor and Perplexity. It is also listed as an official Claude Connector, and a live probe confirms the endpoint is an auth-gated remote MCP server that follows the MCP authorization spec. missing for 10: write/action tools (the server is read-only per its own docs), an enumerated list of the exposed MCP tools.
